sources_admitted.evidence: 58 records pinned under data/sources/air-traffic-control and data/sources/coverage with text and hash; the FAA command-center advisories were fetched from fly.faa.gov and the X posts read with bird, and the White House briefing audio was pinned and transcribed locally, because capture cannot reach them.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: The stop's length, 4 hours 23 minutes, runs from advisory 111's 2053Z start to advisory 005's 0116Z cancellation; O'Hare's stop at 2010Z is 43 minutes before the national order.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: CBS's update account, MS NOW's software-update account, CNN's router account and Bloomberg's FBI account are each stated at their own sourcing; the Houston Chronicle's 2:26 p.m. onset was checked against the briefing audio, which has 3:36, and is not used.

live_elements_guarded.evidence: The page has no live element; counts carry their times (6:04 and 7:15 p.m. FlightAware, 5:50 p.m. Cirium) and the cause is stated as of the November 13 evening briefing.
